notes.title: Patch Notes v2.1.0
notes.content:
Patch Notes v2.1.0

New!

[h2]Global Rankings Are Here![/h2]
The Steam Global Rankings feature has been implemented.
The highest han count achieved in Advanced Mode from now on will be recorded in the global rankings.
Records from before this implementation will not be reflected in the rankings.

How to View the Rankings:
Click "Global Rankings" from "Best Score" to view the rankings in the in-game browser.
The rankings will record the highest han count per Steam account.

notes.title: 【Sky's the Limit MAH-JONG v2.0.0】New Mode "Advanced"!!
notes.content:
Major Update Today: "Sky's the Limit MAH-JONG" Adds New Game Mode: **Advanced Mode!**

The previous game mode is now available as **Standard Mode**, allowing you to continue enjoying it as before.

---

[h2]NEW![/h2]
[h1]What is Advanced Mode?[/h1]

In addition to "Tile Trade" and "Status Enhancement," Advanced Mode introduces powerful new items called **Modules** and a **Yaku Leveling System** that levels up a yaku each time you win with it, enhancing its power.  
Advanced Mode is not about achieving 200 or 300 han; it’s about reaching incomparably higher scores!


[h2]112 Types of Modules[/h2]

Advanced Mode brings 112 unique modules to expand Sky's the Limit MAH-JONG.  
You can acquire up to 8 modules in a single game, each offering more diverse and powerful effects than status enhancement items.  
By selecting from a wide array of modules and maximizing their effects, you can advance to new heights previously unimagined.

[h2]Yaku Levels[/h2]

In Advanced Mode, winning with the same yaku the required number of times will level it up, making the yaku itself stronger.  
For instance, Pinfu at Level 1 is worth 1 han, Pinfu Level 2 is worth 2 han, Pinfu Level 3 is worth 3 han, and so on.  
The more you win, the stronger your yaku becomes.  
In Sky's the Limit MAH-JONG, "There’s no need for only four of the same tile in the wall," and "Pinfu doesn’t have to stay at 1 han!"  
How many han is your Pinfu?


[h3]About Yaku Levels[/h3]

_You can check yaku levels anytime in the "Yaku Table" within the game settings._

- **Normal Yaku:** Levels up and increases han once you win the required number of times.
- **Yakuman and Double Yakuman (max Level 2):** Levels up after winning three times; if there’s an open module slot, a unique module is granted.
- **Yaku Without Levels:** Reach, Double Reach, Ippatsu, Tsumo, Haitei, Rinshan Kaihou, Ichiman Getsu, Kyuman Ryu, Goman Kaika, and various Dora do not level up.

---

[h2]Other New Additions[/h2]
[h1]25 New Local Yaku Added[/h1]

We've added 25 new local yaku!  
In addition to previously included yaku like "Suurenko" and "Dai Shichisei," the game now includes familiar local yaku such as "Big Wheel," "Three years on a rock," "Big Three Winds," and "Red Peacock." Original local yaku unique to Sky's the Limit MAH-JONG, such as "All Same Triples" and "Five Return to One," are also available.  
These new local yaku are playable in both **Standard** and **Advanced** modes.  
For details, you can check the complete list of yaku from the "Yaku Table" in the game settings.


---

**Patch Notes v2.0.0**

**New Features**

- Implemented new mode: "Advanced"
- Added 25 new local yaku
- Added new Steam achievements

**Improvements**

- Changed the UI for calls (meld)
- Modified the item "Mulligan": Items sold in the shop are　"Mulligan+2," allowing mulligans if below the maximum count.
- Adjusted UI

**Bug Fixes**

- Fixed a bug with the "Dead Wall Draw" check during Minkan

notes.title: Update v1.0.1
notes.content:
[h2]Patch Notes v1.0.1[/h2]

- Added "Quality" and "FPS" settings to the options menu.
- Added "How to Play" to the in-game settings.
    - Added the ability to reassign actions other than tile operations to the right-click.
    - Added a feature to display the control guide.

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Fixed an issue where "Enable/Disable (Riichi, Pon, Chi, Kan)" and "Reach while Speed" settings in the in-game options would not persist after restarting the game.
- Added "Return to Title" and "New Game" options to the "End" menu in the in-game settings.
- Changed the "Ron" button to "Win"
- Fixed a bug that caused multiple instances of the results screen to appear.
- Other UI adjustments.

[b]Yaku BUGFIX[/b]
- Fixed a bug with the head (pair) determination in "Thirteen Orphans".
- Fixed a bug with the round count determination for Double Reach and "Blessing of Heaven".
